summary: Port operations and terminal management training for practical berth planning, KPI reporting, and compliance. Learn with real terminal exercises.
lede: Port management training covers the planning and coordination of vessel, berth, yard, gate and cargo activity in a terminal. It is designed for port and terminal professionals, and related logistics staff, who need to manage daily operations and measure performance. Learners practise berth allocation, yard and cargo planning, safety and security reviews, and terminal KPI reporting using operational plans, logs and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work inside port operations, terminal management, or closely connected logistics functions and need stronger control over planning, performance, and compliance. Port Operations Managers coordinating daily terminal execution and berth priorities. Terminal Supervisors controlling yard, gate, and labour performance. Marine Operations Coordinators managing vessel movement and shore readiness. Cargo Planners sequencing container, bulk, and general cargo flows. Safety and Security Officers enforcing ISPS Code and incident controls. Berth Planners allocating windows and quay resources. Terminal Performance Analysts tracking productivity and dwell-time metrics. Stevedoring Supervisors aligning labour with vessel work plans. Port Authority Operations Officers monitoring service levels and compliance. Logistics and Supply Chain Managers interfacing with terminal throughput and inland movement.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or equivalent, and a working understanding of port or terminal operations. If available, bring sample berth schedules, shift handover reports, KPI extracts, or a terminal layout from your workplace for use in exercises.
